sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: IN MID-UPPER LEVELS...SPLIT-FLOW PATTERN FCST TO CONTINUE ON SYNOPTIC SCALE THROUGH UPCOMING DAY-1...BUT WITH CONSIDERABLE SUBSYNOPTIC CHANGES. DESPITE COMPLEXITY OF THIS PATTERN...25/00Z DETERMINISTIC GUIDANCE AND MOST SREF MEMBERS ARE IN REMARKABLY GOOD AGREEMENT ALOFT...E.G. WITH 500 MB FEATURES. PRIMARY MID-UPPER CYCLONE WILL BEGIN PERIOD OVER IL...MOVING SLOWLY EWD TO OH...AS HEIGHTS FALL OVER PORTIONS NERN CONUS SW OF RETROGRADING LABRADOR LOW. MEANWHILE...SHORTWAVE TROUGH NOW ANALYZED OVER MT WILL MOVE SEWD AND AMPLIFY...REACHING CENTRAL/ERN NEB BY 26/12Z WITH TRAILING VORTICITY BANNER NWWD ACROSS BLACK HILLS REGION. ASSOCIATED COOLING ALOFT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES WILL CONTRIBUTE TO GEN TSTM POTENTIAL FARTHER SW ACROSS NRN ROCKIES AND SRN MT. MEANWHILE...WEAKER SHORTWAVE TROUGH -- NOW EVIDENT IN MOISTURE CHANNEL IMAGERY OVER W TX -- WILL MAINTAIN POSITIVE TILT AND MOVE ENEWD ACROSS GA/CAROLINAS BY ABOUT 26/06Z. AT SFC...DEEP CYCLONE NOW ANALYZED INVOF UIN WILL BECOME STACKED WITH MIDLEVEL VORTEX...AND WILL FILL/OCCLUDE. BAROCLINICITY WILL BE REINFORCED ALONG SFC COLD FRONT/DRYLINE NOW EVIDENT OVER SRN IL...WRN KY...WRN TN AND CENTRAL MS. FRONTAL ZONE SHOULD MOVE EWD ACROSS AL

sections.title: SERN CONUS
sections.text: BAND OF SCATTERED TSTMS MAY BE IN PLACE AT START OF PERIOD FROM PORTIONS FL PANHANDLE NEWD OVER GA. RELATED ZONE OF CONVERGENCE/ASCENT WILL SHIFT EWD ALONG/AHEAD OF FRONT AND ACROSS PORTIONS NRN FL...GA AND PERHAPS SC DURING DAY. THIS ACTIVITY MAY REINTENSIFY AS FOREGOING/INFLOW LAYER AIR MASS HEATS DIABATICALLY. VEERING SFC WINDS MAY REDUCE MASS CONVERGENCE SOMEWHAT...HOWEVER THEY ALSO WILL ADVECT RELATIVELY RICH MOISTURE NEWD FROM GULF. AFTERNOON MLCAPE NEAR 1500 J/KG IS POSSIBLE...BENEATH ABOUT 50 KT EFFECTIVE SHEAR MAGNITUDE. DIRECTIONAL SHEAR SHOULD BE SMALL...ALTHOUGH SPEED SHEAR STILL SHOULD BE SUFFICIENT TO LENGTHEN HODOGRAPHS IN SUPPORT OF SUPERCELLS AS WELL AS BOW/LEWP STRUCTURES. SIMILAR BUOYANCY AND SHEAR WILL BE IN PLACE FOR MUCH OF TODAY FARTHER NNEWD ACROSS PIEDMONT AND COASTAL PLAIN REGIONS OF CAROLINAS...WITH SOMEWHAT LOWER DEW POINTS BUT SLIGHTLY COLDER AIR ALOFT. MAIN UNCERTAINTY/CONDITIONALITY OVER THIS AREA WILL BE CONVECTIVE COVERAGE...WHICH SEVERAL MODELS REASONABLY INDICATE COULD BE MORE SPARSE IN ENVIRONMENT OF RELATIVELY WEAK LOW-LEVEL CONVERGENCE. SEVERAL PROGS INDICATE THAT TSTMS MAY CONTINUE OR DEVELOP ANEW THIS EVENING AND OVERNIGHT ACROSS PORTIONS NRN

sections.title: OH VALLEY TO DELMARVA
sections.text: RELATIVELY DENSE CONCENTRATION OF TSTMS IS EXPECTED FROM LATE MORNING THROUGH AFTERNOON INVOF QUASISTATIONARY FRONT. DEEP-LAYER SHEAR SHOULD INCREASE WITH EWD EXTENT FROM INDIANA/OH ACROSS APPALACHIANS TOWARD LOWER POTOMAC RIVER REGION...WHERE VERY SHARP BAROCLINIC GRADIENT AIDED BY COLD MARINE AIR WILL CHARACTERIZE FRONTAL ZONE. NARROW CORRIDOR MAY DEVELOP IN FRONTAL ZONE....OVER SOME PORTIONS NRN VA...MD AND PERHAPS NERN WV...WHERE SFC-BASED BUOYANCY IS JUXTAPOSED WITH BACKED FLOW AND ENHANCED BOUNDARY LAYER VORTICITY. ANY RELATIVELY DISCRETE STORM FORMING IN SOMEWHAT VEERED SFC FLOW OF WARM SECTOR...WITH NEARLY STRAIGHT-LINE HODOGRAPHS...MAY INTENSIFY FOR SHORT PERIOD AND BECOME TORNADIC UPON ENCOUNTERING FRONT. FARTHER W...STEEP DEEP-LAYER LAPSE RATES WILL CONTRIBUTE TO ENHANCED POTENTIAL FOR SVR HAIL -- PRIMARILY WHERE COOLING ALOFT THAT CHARACTERIZES ERN RIM OF MID-UPPER LEVEL CYCLONE SHIFTS OVER AREA OF ENHANCED LOW-LEVEL LIFT OF FRONTAL ZONE. ..EDWARDS/GARNER.. 04/25/2010

sections.title: GA/FL
sections.text: STRONG THUNDERSTORMS PERSIST THIS MORNING OVER PARTS OF SOUTHERN GA/NORTHERN FL/SOUTHEAST SC. VERTICAL SHEAR PROFILES REMAIN QUITE STRONG AS SHOWN IN 12Z RAOBS AT TLH/JAX. HOWEVER...DESPITE VERY MOIST BOUNDARY LAYER...LAPSE RATES ARE NOT PARTICULARLY CONDUCIVE TO STRONG UPDRAFTS. A FEW STORMS IN THIS AREA WILL REMAIN CAPABLE OF OCCASIONAL SUPERCELL CHARACTERISTICS...ALONG WITH A THREAT OF DAMAGING WINDS AND ISOLATED TORNADOES. VERTICAL SHEAR SHOULD DIMINISH BY EARLY AFTERNOON. HOWEVER...STORMS MAY RE-INTENSIFY DURING MAX DIURNAL CYCLE WITH A CONTINUED RISK OF DAMAGING WINDS AND PERHAPS SOME HAIL.

sections.title: OH/WV/PA/MD/DE/NJ
sections.text: LATEST SURFACE ANALYSIS SHOWS THE PRIMARY WARM FRONT EXTENDING FROM NEAR PIT TO NEAR DCA...THEN EASTWARD AND OFF THE COAST. THIS BOUNDARY WILL LIKELY LIFT FARTHER NORTHWARD TODAY AND PROVIDE THE FOCUS FOR SCATTERED AFTERNOON THUNDERSTORMS. STRONG HEATING TO THE SOUTH OF THE BOUNDARY ALONG WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE 60S WILL YIELD MODERATE AFTERNOON CAPE VALUES...WHILE EFFECTIVE SHEAR REMAINS QUITE FAVORABLE FOR ORGANIZED/SUPERCELL STORMS. IT APPEARS THE MOST LIKELY TIME FOR REDEVELOPMENT OF STORMS WILL BE MID AFTERNOON...BEGINNING FIRST NEAR THE LOW OVER OH AND DEVELOPING EASTWARD. HAIL APPEARS LIKELY IN THE STRONGER CELLS IN THIS AREA DUE TO COLD TEMPERATURES ALOFT AND STEEP LAPSE RATES. LOW LEVEL SHEAR WILL ALSO BE SUFFICIENT FOR A RISK OF ISOLATED TORNADOES NEAR THE WARM FRONT OVER SOUTHERN PA/NORTHERN MD/NORTHERN VA AND POSSIBLY EASTWARD INTO DE/NJ THIS EVENING.

sections.title: CAROLINAS
sections.text: AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE HAS RETURNED TO PARTS OF SC/NC TODAY WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S. WATER VAPOR LOOPS SUGGEST RAPID MID LEVEL DRYING WILL OVERSPREAD THIS REGION TODAY...BRINGING STRONG HEATING AND VEERING LOW LEVEL WINDS. SEVERAL MODEL SOLUTIONS SUGGEST THE POTENTIAL FOR ISOLATED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT LATE THIS AFTERNOON OVER EASTERN SC/NC...WITH STORMS TRACKING NORTHEASTWARD TOWARD THE COAST AFTER DARK. IF THIS SCENARIO OCCURS...THERE WOULD BE A RISK OF HAIL AND DAMAGING WINDS IN THE STRONGEST CELLS. ..HART/SMITH.. 04/25/2010

sections.title: SYNOPSIS
sections.text: LARGE...VERTICALLY STACKED LOW CURRENTLY NRN IL WILL MOVE EWD ACROSS OH VALLEY AND GRADUALLY FILL THIS FORECAST PERIOD. THE ASSOCIATED COLD FRONT WILL SURGE EASTWARD AND EXTEND FROM PA INTO THE EASTERN CAROLINAS BY THIS AFTERNOON...THEN TRAILING SOUTHWARD INTO FL. THIS BOUNDARY IS LIKELY TO ONCE AGAIN BE THE FOCUS FOR SCATTERED THUNDERSTORM DEVELOPMENT...AND THE RISK OF A FEW SEVERE STORMS.

sections.title: OH/WV/PA/MD/DE/NJ
sections.text: AIR MASS ACROSS UPPER OH VALLEY HEATED SUFFICIENTLY THIS AM TO REMOVE MUCH OF CINH ALLOWING DEVELOPMENT OF BANDS OF SURFACE BASED THUNDERSTORMS WRN OH. WITH 40-50KT OF SHEAR ALONG WITH 7C/KM LAPSE RATES THERE WILL BE SUFFICIENT INSTABILITY...MLCAPES TO 1000 J/KG...TO SUPPORT STRONG/SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS SPREADING EWD THRU UPPER OH VALLEY THIS AFTERNOON. PRIMARY THREAT WILL BE LARGE HAIL...HOWEVER SHEAR ALSO FAVORS BOWING SEGMENTS/WIND DAMAGE AS WELL. FURTHER E VICINITY THE WARM FRONTAL BOUNDARY WHICH EXTENDS FROM SWRN PA ESEWD TO DELMARVA...PARAMETERS ARE MORE FAVORABLE FOR POTENTIAL SUPERCELL DEVELOPMENT GIVEN THE VEERING LOW LEVEL SHEAR PROFILES. ADDITIONALLY MLCAPES WILL INCREASE TO AOA 1500 J/KG FAVORING BOTH LARGE HAIL AND AN ISOLATED TORNADO THREAT. SEVERE POTENTIAL WILL GRADUALLY DIMINISH WITH LOSS OF SURFACE HEATING BY THIS EVENING.

sections.title: FL/GA
sections.text: THE TRAILING BAND OF PRE-FRONTAL THUNDERSTORMS ACROSS SERN GA AND NRN FL BEING ACTIVATED BY DAYTIME HEATING. WITH STRONG SHEAR IN PLACE AND MLCAPES AOA 1500 J/KG OVER NRN FL PENINSULA AT LEAST ISOLATED SEVERE THUNDERSTORMS...INCLUDING SUPERCELLS WILL TRACK ACROSS THE NRN PENINSULA THRU THIS AFTERNOON. THREAT WILL INCLUDE HAIL/DAMAGING WINDS ALONG WITH TORNADOES WITH ANY SUPERCELL THAT CAN DEVELOP. ACTIVITY WILL SHIFT E OF FL BY THIS EVENING AS LOW LEVEL WINDS VEER AND OVERALL SHEAR DECREASES. ..ERN CAROLINAS... AMPLE LOW LEVEL MOISTURE HAS RETURNED TO PARTS OF SC/NC TODAY WITH DEWPOINTS IN THE MID 60S.
